# Riah Usage
> Free, open-source local dashboard for AI subscription usage meters — Claude, Cursor, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Kimi. Part of Riah Studio.
> Last updated: 2026-08-16
> Repo: https://github.com/RiahStudio/riah-usage

## What this is
- Local dashboard tracking AI subscription usage (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Kimi, and more).
- Runs on your own machine; no accounts, no cloud.
- Answer-first: see exactly how much of each subscription you've burned.

## Quick facts
- Developer: Riah Studio (Riah Harris)
- Platform: local web dashboard (Windows-friendly)
- Data: stays on your machine

## For agents
- Public repo — indexable, cloneable.
- README.md has setup + usage instructions.
- Useful for anyone building tools that monitor AI subscription quotas.
